Ingredients:

  • 2 egg yolks
  • 3 tablespoons butter, melted
  • ½ cup powdered sugar
  • 2 tablespoons fresh squeezed lemon juice
  • 1 tablespoon lemon peel
  • 1 tablespoon sugar
  • 24 mini frozen phyllo shells
  • Raspberries (optional, for garnish)

Directions:

  1. Heat oven to 350 F .Whisk together egg yolks, butter, powdered sugar, lemon juice, lemon peel and sugar in small bowl.
  2. Spoon 1 teaspoon filling into each frozen phyllo shell. Bake about 13-15 minutes, or until center is set.
  3. If desired, garnish each tart with 1 raspberry.
  4. Makes 12 servings (2 tarts per serving)

Nutrition Information per Serving:

  • Calories 162
  • Total Fat 8 g
  • Protein 2 g
  • Carbohydrate 20 g
  • Cholesterol 66 mg
  • Dietary Fiber 0 g
  • Sodium 62 mg

My parents paid my way through college, they set up a fund for my brother and I when we were little and have been feeding into it ever since. My mother's father paid for her, however my father paid his own way through college by working as a carpenter by day and taking night classes.

I joined the army reserve out of high school hoping to get money for college. I didn't get nearly enough to cover tuition, so it's been a constant struggle that's drug into my sixth year because I always have to work two jobs while being a full time engineering student. With my degree, that should be easily repayable
